premises.text: Couples need a way to address relationship challenges that fits everyday life when therapy alone is not working
premises.evidence_span: LifeCouple is a platform that allows couples to address relationship challenges in a way that's suitable for their everyday life

premises.text: Metric-driven onboarding and a proprietary algorithm identify key relationship areas such as communication, trust, intimacy, and conflict
premises.evidence_span: taken a metric-driven onboarding questionnaire, and through a proprietary algorithm, four key areas of the relationship have now been filled

premises.text: Check-ins, alerts, and AI/ML offer ways to close gaps between current and desired relationship satisfaction
premises.evidence_span: through alerts and AI and machine learning, the couple is now offered ways to bring the gap between where they're at in their satisfaction level to be one

premises.text: Guided icebreakers help partners communicate about hard topics without escalating conflict
premises.evidence_span: Jack is going to do something that we call icebreaker

premises.text: Relationship challenges, digital gifts via love languages, and AI-suggested dates/videos keep relationships healthy
premises.evidence_span: other areas such as relationship challenges, other areas such as digital gifts with the five love languages

premises.text: Therapists can use the platform as a treatment plan between sessions so homework is not lost on paper
Unlike competitors, LifeCouple tracks and monitors relationship health
premises.evidence_span: no one tracks and no one monitors the health of one's relationship

premises.text: Go-to-market partners with therapy and Employment Assistance Programs rather than replacing therapy
premises.evidence_span: we have built a partnership because we complement therapy
